definition: Calendar year of the NCRB Crime in India report
methodology: NCRB annual compilation from state/UT returns
limitations: Report publication typically lags the reference year by 9-18 months

definition: Count of FIRs registered under IPC Section 375/376 in the reference year
methodology: Police FIR registration compiled by NCRB from State/UT returns
limitations: Reflects REPORTED crime only, not true incidence - see README interpretation warning
missing_value_reason: NA = figure not independently verified in this build; see notes column
comparability_notes: Not comparable pre/post 2013 Criminal Law Amendment or pre/post 2024 IPC-to-BNS transition without legal crosswalk

definition: TRUE if this build traced the figure to a specific cited report; FALSE if unverified/derived
methodology: Manual verification against sources.csv during research pass
limitations: Binary flag only - see sources.csv notes field for qualitative assessment

definition: Name of the State or Union Territory per NCRB classification
methodology: Standardized geographic naming per geography.csv
comparability_notes: See geography.csv for boundary changes (Telangana 2014, J&K/Ladakh 2019)

definition: Calendar year of the NCRB Crime in India report (2014-2022)
methodology: CHRI compilation from NCRB CII Table 3A.1 returns

definition: Annual count of FIRs registered under IPC 376 in the given State/UT and year
methodology: Annual police FIR registration compiled by NCRB
limitations: Reflects reporting behavior, police registration practices, and legal awareness, not true underlying incidence
missing_value_reason: NA = data not available for that administrative entity in that year
comparability_notes: State-to-state comparisons must account for population differences and reporting barriers

definition: Name of the State or Union Territory containing the district
methodology: Standardized administrative state/UT grouping

definition: Name of the police administrative district, city commissionerate, or railway police district as reported to NCRB
methodology: NCRB district-level compilation (Table 3A.1)
limitations: Police districts do not always perfectly align with revenue/census districts; includes specialized jurisdictions (e.g. Railway Police)
missing_value_reason: Districts created mid-period appear in years post-creation
comparability_notes: District reorganization and bifurcations across 2015-2022 affect longitudinal continuity for specific jurisdictions

definition: Count of FIRs registered under IPC 376 in the given district and year
methodology: Annual district police FIR compilation by NCRB
limitations: Zero counts reflect zero registered FIRs, which frequently indicates extreme underreporting or lack of police access rather than absence of crime (see CHRI Part 3 analysis on zero-reporting districts)
comparability_notes: Zero-reporting analysis in CHRI Part 3 highlights institutional barriers

definition: Offence category: 'Rape (IPC 376)', 'Rape/gangrape with murder', or 'Crime against women (all CAW - NOT rape-specific)'. NEVER merge across categories.
methodology: NCRB category definitions per definitions.csv
limitations: Rape/gangrape with murder is legally and statistically distinct from plain rape (IPC 376)
comparability_notes: Distinct legal categories with different baseline frequencies

definition: Specific stage metric: e.g. chargesheeting_rate, conviction_rate, trial_pendency_rate, insufficient_evidence_closure_cases
methodology: NCRB disposal tables compiled and analyzed by CHRI Part 2
limitations: Person-level data reflects new cases only due to NCRB recording methodology
comparability_notes: Check denominator_definition column carefully before comparing rates across stages

definition: Quantitative value (count in cases/persons or rate in percent)
methodology: Calculated per standard NCRB disposal formulas as detailed in definitions.csv
limitations: Conviction rate denominator = trials completed that year, NOT cases registered that year
comparability_notes: Phase 3 added ~200 rape-specific national rows for 2017-2022

definition: Prevalence, help-seeking, or reporting metric measured via representative household surveys (NFHS-5)
methodology: Demographic and Health Survey (DHS) methodology with specialized domestic violence module
limitations: Self-reported responses subject to recall and social desirability bias; excludes non-household populations
comparability_notes: Survey sampling frames differ from police FIR records; survey estimates should never be used as a simple multiplier on FIR counts

definition: Percentage or proportion estimated from survey sample
methodology: Weighted sample estimates per IIPS NFHS-5 report

definition: Documentation of state reorganization (Telangana bifurcation in 2014, Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh UT reorganization in 2019) and police reporting anomalies
source: compiled from official state reorganization acts and NCRB documentation
methodology: Qualitative historical compilation

definition: Total annual rape cases registered nationally
methodology: CHRI Table 6 compilation from NCRB
limitations: Annual total against which SC/ST cases are benchmarked

human_readable_name: SC/ST PoA Act rape cases registered
definition: Registered rape cases booked under the SC/ST Prevention of Atrocities Act
methodology: NCRB Crime Against SCs/STs chapters recompiled by CHRI
limitations: Specific to cases registered under SC/ST (PoA) Act; separate from non-PoA rape cases
comparability_notes: Share of total rape cases increased from 6.08% in 2014 to 13.46% in 2022

human_readable_name: SC/ST share of total rape cases (%)
definition: Percentage of total registered rape cases booked under SC/ST PoA Act
methodology: Calculated: (rape_cases_under_scst_poa_act / total_rape_cases) * 100
limitations: Proportion based on registered cases only

definition: Total individual survivors recorded in registered rape cases
methodology: CHRI Table 7 compilation from NCRB Table 3A.2(i)
limitations: Victims/survivors counted at individual person level (cases may have multiple survivors)

definition: Total survivors belonging to SC/ST communities in registered rape cases
methodology: CHRI Table 7 compilation from NCRB Table 7A.2
limitations: Subset of total survivors; includes adult women and girl-children

definition: SC/ST rape survivors aged 18 years and above
methodology: NCRB Table 7A.2 compilation by CHRI

definition: SC/ST rape survivors under 18 years of age
methodology: NCRB Table 7A.2 compilation by CHRI
limitations: CHRI flags an internal NCRB inconsistency for 2022 where Table 7A.2 SC/ST girl-child count (1413) exceeds Table 3A.2(i) all-category girl-child count (1004)
comparability_notes: Flagged and preserved as reported in official tables without silent alteration
